rows.output: Oníṣègùn Ojogbon Brian O'Hagan sọ pé: 'Ìwádìí náà wà ní ìpele ìbèrè ṣùgbọ́n mo fẹ́ kán sí ẹnìkan tí ó bá wà ní àgbègbè John Street ní Birkenhead tí ó rí tàbí gbọ́ ohunkóhun tí ó dàbí ẹ̀ṣọ́ kan láti kán sí wa.

rows.output: "Nígbà tí ewu ìjì líle náà ti wáyé lánàá, àwọn ènìyàn ṣì ń ṣe àwọn iṣẹ́ wọn ní etíkun tí wọ́n kò sì sáré lọ ní kíákíá, wọ́n sì di àwọn olùfarapa,” Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, agbẹnusọ fún ilé iṣẹ́ ìdènà ìṣòro ìṣòro BNPB ní Indonesia, sọ ní ìpàdé kan ní Jakarta.
rows.reference: ''Nigbati ìdúnkoòkò tsunami náà dìde ní àná, àwọn eniyan sì ńṣe iṣẹ́ wọn létíkun tíwọn kòsì sá kuro lójú-ẹsẹ̀ tí wọ́n sì di ẹniti o farakó-áásá,'' ni Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, agbẹnusọ fún àjọ tó ńrísí díndín ewu ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù kù lorilẹ-ede Indonesia BNPB sọ nínú ìfitónilétí kan Jarkata.

rows.output: Ìjì líle náà kò wá ní ìbànújẹ́, ó mú àwọn ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́, àwọn igi, àwọn ilé, ó sì kọlu ohun gbogbo tí ó wà lórí ilẹ̀, ”Nugroho sọ pé, ó sì fi kù pé ìjì líle náà ti rin ìrìn àjò lórí òkun ṣíwájú ní ìwọ̀n 800 kmph (497 mph) kí ó tó kọlu etíkun.
rows.reference: Ìkún-omi tsunami náà kòwá nípa ara rẹ̀, ó wọ́ àwọn ọkọ́ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́, àwọn igi, àwọn ilé, ó kọlu ohun gbogbo lórí ilẹ̀,'' ni Nugroho sọ, tí ó sì fikún un pé ìkún-omi tsunami náà ti rin ìrìn-àjò kọjá gbangba òkun ní àwọn ìwọ̀n ìṣọwọ́sáré kìlómítà ẹgbẹ̀jọ̀ ní wákàtí kan (máìlí 497 ní wákàtí kan) kí ó tó kọlu bèbè òkun.

rows.output: Àwọn ènìyàn kan gun igi láti sá lọ́wọ́ ìjìyà náà, ó sọ.

rows.output: Àwọn ìjìyà ilẹ̀ náà ni a rí ní agbègbè tí ó ní ènìyàn 2.4 mílíọ̀nù.

rows.output: Ìjọba fún Àyẹ̀wò àti Ìmúṣẹ̀ Ìmúṣẹ̀ Ìmúṣẹ̀ (BPPT) ti Indonesia sọ nínú ìkéde pé agbára tí ìbànújẹ́ ńlá náà tú sílè ní ọjọ́ Jimọ̀ ni ó tó ìlà ọgọ́rùn-ún [200] ìgbà agbára bọ́mù àtọ́míkì tí a ju sí Hiroshima ní Ogun Àgbáyé Kejì.

rows.reference: Ìbéèrè náà lóri ìwé àmútẹ̀kasí fún ìbò oníbẹ́ẹ̀ni-bẹ́ẹ̀kọ́ náà kà báyìí: ''Ṣe o faramọ́ ìjọ́mọ-ẹgbẹ́ àjọ NATO àti EU pẹ̀lú ìtẹ́wọ́gbà ti àdéhùn náà pẹ̀lú orilẹ-ede Gíríkì.''.

rows.output: Àwọn alátìlẹ́yìn fún orúkọ ìyípadà náà, lára ​​àwọn tí ó ní Prime Minister Zoran Zaev, sọ pé ó jẹ́ owó tí ó tọ́ láti ṣe ìlépa ìmúṣẹ sí àwọn ara ìlú bíi EU àti NATO fún Masedoniya, ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ó jáde láti inú ìparun Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Àwọn alátìlẹyìn ti ìyípadà orúkọ náà, pẹ̀lú Adarí Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìjọba Zoran Zaev, wí àwíjàre wipe ó jẹ́ ìdíyelé tóyẹ kan láti san láti leè lépa ìgbaniwọlé sinu àwọn àjọ bíi EU àti NATO fún Masidóníà, ọ̀kan ninu àwọn orilẹ̀-ede tó yọ jáde síta láti inú ìwólulẹ̀ ti Orilẹ-ede Yugosilafia.

rows.output: "Mo wá l'ónìí láti dìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orílẹ̀-èdè náà, fún àwọn ọmọdé ní Masedóníà kí wọn lè máa gbé ní òmìnira lábẹ́ àpáta ti Ìparapọ̀ Yúróòpù nítorí pé ó túmọ̀ sí ìgbésí ayé àbójútó fún gbogbo wa," ni Olivera Georgijevska, 79, sọ ní Skopje.
rows.reference: Mó wá lóòní láti di ìbò fún ọjọ́ iwájú orilẹ-ede náà, fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Masidóníà kí wọ́n leè máa gbé ní òmìnira lábẹ́ agboòrùn ti Àjọ Àwọn Orilẹ-ede Yuroopu nitoripe ó túmọ̀ sí àwọn ìgbésí ayé aláìléwu púpọ̀ síi fún gbogbo wa,'' gẹgẹ bíi Olivera Georgijevska, ẹni ọdún mọ́kàndínlọ́gọ́rin ṣe sọ, ní ìlú Skopje.

rows.output: Bó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò ní ìdájọ́ òfin, àwọn ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn aṣòfin ti sọ pé wọ́n á tẹ̀lé àbájáde ìbò náà, èyí tó mú kí ó ṣe pàtàkì.
rows.reference: Botilẹjepe kìí ṣe àdéhùn tó ńfipá múni lábẹ̀ òfin, àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin tí ó tóníye ti sọpé àwọn faramọ̀ àbájáde ìbò náà láti ṣeé ní eyiti ẹnu rẹ̀ múlẹ̀.

rows.output: Ìyípadà orúkọ náà yóò nílò ìdá méjì nínú mẹ́ta nínú ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin.
rows.reference: Ìyípadà orúkọ náà yóò nílò ìdá méjì tópọ̀jù ninu ìdá mẹ́ta àwọn ọmọ ilé ìgbìmọ aṣojú-ṣòfin.

rows.output: Ìgbìmọ̀ ìdìbò ìpínlẹ̀ náà sọ pé kò sí ìrònú àìtọ́ tí a ti gbọ́ ní aago 1 ìrọ̀lù.
rows.reference: Ìgbìmọ̀ amúṣẹ́ṣe lori ìdìbò ti orilẹ-ede náà sọpé kòsí àwọn ìròyìn àìṣedéédéé kankan títí aago méjì ọ̀sán.

Bótiwùkórí, ìjáde-dìbò dúró ní ìdá mẹ́rìndínlógún ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀run, bí a ṣafiwé rẹ̀ sì ìdá mẹ́rìnlélọ́gbọ̀n ti inú ìdìbò àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin tókọjá lọ́dún 2016 nigbati ìdá mẹ́rìndínláàádọ́rin àwọn olùdìbò tó forúkọ sílẹ̀ fi ìwé àmútẹkasí láti dìbo wọn sílẹ̀.

rows.output: Mo ti jade lati dibo nitori awọn ọmọ mi, aaye wa ni Yuroopu," ni Gjose Tanevski, 62, oludibo ni olu-ilu, Skopje.
rows.reference: ''Mo jáde síta láti dìbò nitori àwọn ọmọ mi, ipò wa wà ninu Yuroopu,'' gẹgẹ bíi Gjose Tanevski, ẹni ọdún méjìlélọ́gọ́ta, olùdìbo kan ní olù-ìlú náà, Skopje ṣe sọ.

rows.output: Mambobin Majalisar (AMs) na Wales suna damuwa game da "yadda suke kallon muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AMs ta damu game da 'yadda ake zama kamar wawaye'

rows.output: Akwai damuwa a tsakanin wasu AMs game da shawarar canjin taken su zuwa MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).
rows.reference: Akwai tsoron haɗari a tsakanin wasu AMs a bisa shawarar canza muƙaminsu zuwa MWPs (Mamban Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh).

rows.output: Ya taso ne saboda shawarwarin sauya sunan majalisar zuwa Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: Abin ya tashi ne saboda shirye-shirye na canza sunan taron zuwa Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh.

rows.output: AMs a fannonin siyasa daban-daban suna damuwa cewa hakan na iya jawo haske.
rows.reference: AM a ɓangaren siyasa sun damu ƙwarai don zai iya haifar da ba’a.

rows.output: Wani memba na jam'iyyar Labour ya ce, "muna damuwa cewa yana kama da Twp da Pwp."
rows.reference: Wani AM na Jam’iyyar Labour ya ce ƙungiyar ta damu "yana rauji da Twp da kuma Pwp."

rows.output: Ga masu karanta a waje da Wales: A cikin Welsh, twp yana nufin daft da pwp yana nufin kuka.
rows.reference: Don masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin hauka kuma pwp yana nufin kashi.

rows.output: Wani memba na jam'iyyar Plaid ya ce "ba su yi farin ciki ba" kuma ya ba da shawarar wasu madadin.
rows.reference: Wani Plaid AM ya ce gungun gaba ɗaya “ba su ji daɗi ba” kuma ya ba da shawarar zaɓuɓɓuka.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Conservative na Wales ya ce "suna bude zuciya" game da canjin suna, amma ya lura cewa hakan yana da gajeren tazara daga MWP zuwa Muppet.
rows.reference: Wani mai ra’ayin riƙau na Welsh ya ce gungun “ba shi da wani abu a zuciya” game da canza sunan, amma ya lura wani ɗan gajeren bayani ne daga MWP zuwa Muppet.

rows.output: A wannan mahallin harafin Welsh w ana furta shi kamar yadda ake furta harafin u a Yorkshire English.
rows.reference: A wannan bigiren, ana furta harafin w na Welsh ne kwatankwacin furucin Turanci na Yorshire na harafin u.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar, wadda a halin yanzu tana tsara dokar gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce: "Shawarar karshe kan duk wani sunan da ake kira 'yan majalisar za ta kasance a hannun 'yan majalisar da kansu."
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar, wanda a yanzu haka ke rubuta daftarin dokar don gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce:  “Hukuncin ƙarshe a kan kowaɗanne abubuwa masu bayyanarwa abin da ake kiran mambobi na Majalisar zai kasance kuwa wani batu ne don mambobin da kansu.”

rows.output: Dokar Gwamnatin Wales ta 2017 ta ba da ikon ga Majalisar Wales ta canza sunan ta.
rows.reference: Dokar Gwamnatin Welsh ta 2017 ta ba wa majalisar Welsh iko na canza sunanta.

rows.output: A watan Yuni, Hukumar ta buga sakamakon wani tattaunawa na jama'a kan shawarwarin da suka samu goyon baya mai faɗi na kiran majalisar a matsayin Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.output: A kan batun sunan AMs, Hukumar ta goyi bayan 'Yan Majalisar Wales ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi yawan goyon baya a wani bincike na jama'a.
rows.reference: A kan batun sunan AMs ɗin, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi goyon bayan a cikin wata tattaunawar jama’a.

rows.output: AMs suna da alama suna ba da wasu zaɓuɓɓuka, amma ƙoƙarin cimma matsaya na iya zama matsala ga Shugabar, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran za ta gabatar da kundin tsarin mulki kan canje-canjen cikin makonni.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.output: Dokar gyare-gyare za ta hada da sauran canje-canje ga yadda majalisar ke aiki, ciki har da dokoki kan cirewar mambobi da kuma tsarin kwamitin.
rows.reference: Dokar a kan canje-canjen za su haɗa da sauran canje-canje na yadda majalisar ke aiki, da ya haɗa da ƙa’idoji a kan ayyana rashin cancanta na AMs da kuma tsara tsari na kwamitin.

rows.output: AMs za su samu karshe na kuri'a kan tambayar yadda za a kira su lokacin da suka tattauna dokar.
rows.reference: AMs za su sami kaɗa kuri’ar karshe a kan batun abin da za a kira su da shi a yayin da suka yi mahawarar dokar.

rows.output: Macedoniyawa za su je rumfunan zaɓe a zaben da za a yi kan sauya sunan kasar
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia sun tafi yin zaɓuɓɓuka a cikin zaɓen raba gardama a kan canza sunan kasar

rows.output: Masu jefa kuri'a za su jefa kuri'a a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan kasar su zuwa "Jamhuriyar Arewa Masedoniya."
rows.reference: Masu kada kuri’a za su yi zaɓe a kan ko su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Macedonia ta Arewa.”

rows.output: An kafa kuri'ar jama'a ne a kokarin warware takaddama da ta dade da makwabtanta kasar Girka, wadda ke da yankin da ake kira Macedonia.
rows.reference: An saita sanannen zaɓen ne don wani ƙoƙari na warware wani rikicin da ya yi shekara da shekara tare da makwaɓciyar ƙasa ta Greece, wadda ke da lardinta da ake kira Macedonia.

rows.output: Athens ta yi tsokaci na tsawon lokaci cewa sunan makwabcinta na arewa yana wakiltar ikirari kan yankin ta, kuma ta ci gaba da adawa da nema ta shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Athens ta jima tana jajircewa cewa sunan makwaɓciyarta daga arewaci yana wakiltar wani ƙorafi ne a kan yankinta kuma ta sha maimaita ƙin neman matsayin mamba a Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Shugaban Macedoniya Gjorge Ivanov, wanda ya yi adawa da zaben da ya shafi canjin sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da wannan zabe.
rows.reference: Shugaban Ƙasar Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, wani mai adawa da tsarin zaɓen kai tsaye a kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaɓen.

rows.output: Duk da haka, masu goyon bayan zaben sun hada da Firaministan Zoran Zaev, suna jayayya cewa canjin sunan kawai farashin da za a biya don shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaɓen raba gardamar, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna mahawara cewa canza sunan wani ɗan aiki ne da dole a yi don a shiga Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Sautin Agogo na St. Martin's ya yi shuru yayin da Cocin a Harlem ke fama da matsala
rows.reference: Ƙararrawar St. Martin's Sun yi Shiru Saboda Majami’u a cikin Harlem suna cikin Gwargwarmaya

rows.output: "A tarihi, tsofaffin mutane da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kowane kusurwa," in ji Mista Adams.
rows.reference: “A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai wata mashaya da wata majami’a a kowace kusurwa,” Inji Mista Adams.

rows.output: "A yau, babu komai."
rows.reference: “A yau kuwa, babu ko ɗaya.”

rows.output: Ya ce bacewar mashaya ta zama ruɗani.
rows.reference: Ya ce ɓacewa ta mashayun abu ne na fahimta.

rows.output: "Yanzu mutane suna mu'amala da juna ta hanyar da ta bambanta"
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.output: "An daina ganin mashaya a matsayin dakunan cin abinci na unguwa inda mutane ke zuwa akai-akai."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.output: Game da majami'u, yana damuwa cewa kudi daga sayar da kadarori ba zai dore na tsawon lokaci kamar yadda shuwagabanni suke tsammani ba, "kuma ba da jimawa ba za su dawo inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.output: Cocin, ya kara, za a iya maye gurbinsu da gine-gine na gidan zama da gidan haya da cike da mutane irin su waɗanda ba za su taimaka wa majami'u da suka rage a cikin unguwar ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.output: "Yawancin mutanen da suke siyan gidajen haya a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance fari ne," ya ce, "sannu kuma za su hanzarta ranar da waɗannan majami'u za su rufe gaba ɗaya saboda ba a yi tsammanin cewa yawancin mutanen da za su koma wajen zama a cikin waɗannan gidajen haya za su zama mambobin waɗannan majami'u ba."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.output: Dukkan majami'u biyu an gina su ne ta hanyar al'ummomin fari kafin Harlem ta zama birni mai yawan baƙi - Majami'ar Al'umma a shekarar 1870, St. Martin a shekara ta 1880.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.output: Ƙungiyoyin Methodist na asali sun bar a cikin shekarun 1930.
rows.reference: Asalin farar fata mahalarta ‘yan Methodist sun fita ne a cikin shekaru na 1930.

rows.output: Wani gungun jama'a da suka yi ibada a kusa da su suka karɓi ginin.
rows.reference: Wani taron masu ibada baƙaƙe da ke yin ibada a kusa suka mallaki ginin.

rows.output: An karɓi St. Martin ta wani gungun baƙar fata a ƙarƙashin Jagoran Rev. John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci yajin aikin masu sayar da kayan sayayya a kan titin 125, babbar hanya ta siyayya a Harlem, waɗanda suka ki daukar ma'aikata ko kuma su kara musu albashi.
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.output: Wutar da ta taso a shekarar 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma yayin da mabiyan Father Johnson suka shirya sake gina shi, sun ba da umarnin yin kararrawa.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.output: Malam David Johnson, ɗan Malamin Johnson da ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, ya yi alfahari da cewa "karan kararrawa ne na talakawa."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.output: Kwararren mai kida wanda ya buga kararrawa a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu: "Al'adar al'ada" da "kayan tarihi mara maye gurbin."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.output: Kwararre, Tiffany Ng daga Jami'ar Michigan, ta lura cewa ita ce motar farko a duniya da ta kasance mai wasa da baƙar fata, Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya koma babban motar a Cocin Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.
rows.reference: Kwararren, Tiffany Ng na Jami’ar Michigan, har ila yau ya lura cewa shi ne kayan kiɗa na farko a duniya da wani mawaki baƙar fata ya rera, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya motsa babban kayan kiɗan a Majami’ar Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.

rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's bai maye gurbinsa ba.

rows.output: A cikin watanni da suka gabata, labarun da suka shafi masu zanen gine-gine da masu aikin gini, wasu da limaman cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma ta cocin Episcopal, sun yi ta zagayawa a St. Martin.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.output: Majalisar - jikin al'umma, wanda ya ƙunshi shuwagabanni na layi - ya rubuta ga diocese a watan Yuli da damuwarsu cewa diocese "zai yi ƙoƙarin watsar da farashi" ga majalisar, duk da cewa majalisar ba ta shiga cikin daukar masanan gine-gine da masu aikin da diocese ta tura ba.
rows.reference: Sai kwamitin vestry ɗin - hukumar gudanar da yankin iyakar majami’ar, da ta haɗa da shugabanni da ba su da ilimi - sun rubuta wa babban limamin a Yuli da damuwowinsu cewa yankin iyakar majami’ar “zai nemi mika kuɗaɗen da aka kashe” zuwa kwamitin vestry ɗin, duk da cewa ba a sa kwamitin vestry ɗin ba a yin hayar masu zanen da ‘yan kwangilar da yankin iyakar majami’ar suka sa ba.

rows.output: Wasu mambobin cocin sun yi korafi game da rashin gaskiya a kan bangaren cocin.

rows.output: A matsayin wani bangare na babban tunkarar da aka yi zuwa kasuwar kyawun Birtaniya ta £2.8bn, wanda ke ci gaba da karuwa yayin da sayar da kayan kwalliya da kayan daki ke raguwa, manyan sassan kyawun za a gwada su a shaguna 11 a faɗin kasar, kuma a kai su wasu shaguna a shekarar gaba idan ya yi nasara.
rows.reference: A matsayin ɓangaren shiga cikin kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya ta Fam biliyan 2.8, wadda ke ci gaba da haɓaka duk da cewa cinikayyar ado da kayan gida ta sami koma baya, za a gwada manyan ɓangarorin kwalliya a shaguna 11 na kasar kuma a ɗauke su zuwa ƙarin shaguna a shekara mai zuwa idan abin ya ci wata nasara.

rows.output: Zuba jari a cikin kyawawan halaye ya zo ne a lokacin da shagunan sayar da kayan abinci ke neman hanyoyi don amfani da sarari da aka yi amfani da su a baya don talabijin, na'urar dafa abinci, da kayan daki.
rows.reference: Zuba jari a harkar kwalliya yana zuwa ne kamar yadda manyan shagunan sayar da kaya ke fafutukar hanyoyi don yin amfani da gurbin da babu kome da a da na ajiye talabijoji ne, da na’urorin dafa abinci da kayan gida.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ta ce za ta ninka kayan kwalliya har zuwa samfura 3,000, gami da alamu kamar Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman da Dr. PawPaw a karon farko.

rows.output: Kasuwannin da ake da su na L'Oreal, Maybelline daurti Bees za su samu karuwar sarari tare da wuraren da aka yiwa lakabi kamar yadda ake samun su a shagunan kamar Boots.

rows.output: Kantin sayen kayan abinci kuma yana sake kaddamar da layin kayan shafa na Boutique don haka mafi yawan kayan suna da dadi ga masu cin ganyayyaki - wani abu da ake buƙata sosai da matasan masu siye.

rows.output: Bugu da ƙari, mai sayar da turare, The Fragrance Shop, zai gwada shagunan sayar da kayan abinci a cikin shagunan Sainsbury's guda biyu, na farko da aka buɗe a Croydon, kudu London, a makon da ya gabata, yayin da na biyu ya buɗe a Selly Oak, Birmingham, a ƙarshen wannan shekarar.
rows.reference: Kari a kan haka, mai sarin turare wato Shagon Turare zai gwada samar da rangwame a cikin shagunan Sainsbury's guda biyu, na farkonsu wanda ya buɗe a cikin Croydon, kudancin Landan, makon da ya wuce sa’an nan na biyun zai buɗe a cikin Selly Oak, Birmingham, daga baya cikin wannan shekarar.

rows.output: Siyan kan layi da kuma sauya zuwa siyan ƙananun kayan abinci a kai a kai a shagunan da ke kusa da su yana nufin dole ne manyan shagunan su yi ƙarin ƙoƙari don su sa mutane su ziyarta.
rows.reference: Sayan kaya ta yanar gizo da ‘yar matsawa zuwa sayan abinci kadan a kowace rana a shaguna masu samar da sauki na gida yana nufi ya zama dole manyan shagunan sayar da kayan su himmatu wajen jan hankalin mutane su ziyarta.

rows.output: Mike Coupe, shugaban kamfanin Sainsbury's, ya ce shagunan za su yi kama da shagunan sashe-she a hanzari yayin da kantin sayar da kayan abinci ke kokarin kare kansu daga kasuwar rangwame ta Aldi da Lidl da karawa sabis da kuma kayan abinci.

rows.output: Sainsbury's ta sanya wuraren Argos a cikin ɗaruruwan shaguna kuma ta gabatar da wasu wuraren Habitats tun da ta sayi duka sarkar biyu shekaru biyu da suka wuce, wanda ta ce ya ƙara sayar da kayan abinci da kuma sanyawa sayen sarkar ya fi riba.

rows.output: Sainsbury ta gwada haɗin gwiwa da Boots a farkon shekarun 2000, amma an dakatar da haɗin gwiwar bayan rikici kan yadda za a raba kudaden shagon magani a cikin shagunan su.

rows.output: Sabuwar dabarar ta zo ne bayan Sainsbury ta sayar da kasuwancinta na shagon magani 281 ga Celesio, mai Lloyds Pharmacy, akan fam miliyan 125, shekaru uku da suka wuce.

rows.output: Ta ce Lloyds za ta taka rawa a cikin shirin, ta hanyar ƙara nau'in kayan gyaran fata na alfarma da suka haɗa da La Roche-Posay da Vichy a cikin shaguna hudu.

rows.output: Yayin da Save the Children ke tattara tawagar da za ta tafi Palu, har yanzu ba a tabbatar da ko ma'aikata na waje za su iya aiki a filin.

rows.output: Mista Sutopo, mai magana da yawun hukumar bala'i ta kasa, ya ce jami'an Indonesia suna tantance halin da ake ciki a Palu don ganin ko za a bari hukumomin kasa da kasa su ba da gudunmawa wajen taimakon bala'in.
rows.reference: Mista Sutopo, mai magana da yawun hukumar haɗura ta ƙasa, ya ce jami’an Indonesiya suna auna yanayin na cikin Palu don ganin ko za a bari wakilan ƙasa-da-ƙasa su ba da gudunmawa ga ƙoƙarin tallafi.

rows.output: A cikin wannan yanayin da ke ci gaba da faruwa a Indonesia, ƙasar ta kasance cikin mawuyacin hali game da shiri don fushin halitta.
rows.reference: Ganin jijjigar ƙasa da Indonesiya ta saba gani, ƙasar ta zama ta yi mummunan rashin shiryawa don bala’in rayuwa.

rows.output: Duk da cewa an gina sansanonin tsunami a Aceh, ba su da yawa a kan sauran bakin teku.
rows.reference: Duk da cewa an gina matsugunan Tsunami a cikin Aceh, ba su zama abin da ake iya gani a yankunan da ke kusa da bakin ruwa ba.

rows.output: Rashin bayyana siren na tsunami a Palu, duk da cewa an yi gargadi, yana yiwuwa ya ba da gudummawa ga asarar rayuka.
rows.reference: Rashin jiniyar gargarɗin tsunami da ya fito a fili a cikin Palu, duk da cewa wani gargaɗi yana aiki, zai iya yiwuwa shi ne ya ba da gudunmawa ga rasa rayuwa.

rows.output: A lokacin da ya fi kyau, tafiya tsakanin tsibirai da yawa na Indonesia yana da wahala.
rows.reference: A lokuta mafiya kyau, bulaguro tsakanin tsibiran Indonesiya masu yawa yana da ƙalubale.

rows.output: Bala'o'i na halitta suna sa aikin jigilar kaya ya zama mai wahala.
rows.reference: Haɗuran da Allah ya aiko sukan sa rabe-raben kayan buƙata ya zama da wahala sosai.

rows.output: Jirgin asibiti da aka sanya a Lombok domin kula da wadanda suka jikkata a girgizar kasa, yana kan hanyar zuwa Palu, amma zai dauki akalla kwanaki uku kafin ya kai wurin bala'in da ya faru.
rows.reference: Wani asibitin jirgin ruwa da aka ajiye a cikin Lombok yana kan hanyarsa ta zuwa Palu don kula da waɗanda girgizar ƙasar ta shafa, amma zai ɗauki aƙalla kwanaki uku kafin isa wurin sabon bala’in.

rows.output: Shugaban Joko Widodo ya sauya tsarin samar da ababen more rayuwa na Indonesia, wanda ya kasance cikin mawuyacin hali, ya zama babban abu a yakin neman zabensa, kuma ya kashe kudi mai yawa a kan hanyoyin mota da layin dogo.
rows.reference: Shugaba Ƙasa Joko Widodo ya maida inganta gine-ginen Indonesiya da suka lalace abin da ya sa a gaba na kamfe ɗin zaɓensa, kuma ya zuba kuɗi mai yawa a kan hanyoyi da hanyoyin jirgin ƙasa.

rows.output: Amma rashin kuɗin da ya yi ya janyo wa gwamnatin Mr. Joko matsala, yayin da yake fuskantar sake zaɓe a shekara mai zuwa.
rows.reference: Amma rashin isassun kuɗaɗe ya addabi gwamnatin Mista Joko a lokacin da yake fuskantar sake zaɓe a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.output: Mista Joko kuma yana fuskantar matsin lamba daga tashin hankali na addini da ya dade a Indonesia, inda mambobin rinjaye na Musulunci suka rungumi wani nau'in addinin da ya fi tsauri.
rows.reference: Haka kuma Mista Joko yana fuskantar matsi daga tashin-tashina bambanci addini da ya-ƙi-ci-ya-ƙi-cinyewa, inda mamobin Musulmai da suka fi rinjaye suka karɓi nau’in addini tsatstsaura.

rows.output: A sama da mutane 1,000 ne suka mutu, kuma dubban mutane sun rasa matsugunansu yayin da gungun Kiristoci da Musulman suka yi ta fada a kan tituna, suna amfani da wukake, baka, da kibau, da sauran makaman da ba su da kaifi.
rows.reference: An kashe fiye da mutane 1,000 kuma dubun-dubata sun rasa matsugunai daga gidajensu kamar yadda ‘yan daba Kirista da Musulmai ke ta yaƙi a kan tituna, suna masu yin amfani da adduna, kwari da baka, da sauran muggan makamai.

rows.output: Kalli: Kwallon Liverpool ta Daniel Sturridge ta yi daidaito da Chelsea
rows.reference: Kalli: Daniel Sturridge na Liverpool ya jawo kunnen doki da  Chelsea

rows.output: Daniel Sturridge ya ceci Liverpool daga rashin nasara a gasar Premier da Chelsea da ci a mintuna 89 a ranar Asabar a Stamford Bridge da ke Landan.
rows.reference: Daniel Sturridge ya kare Liverpool daga wani wasa kofin ƙalubale na Premier League inda ya yi hasara ga Chelsea tare da ci a cikin mintina na 89 a ranar Asabar a Stamford Bridge a cikin Landan.

rows.output: Sturridge ya karɓi watsawa daga Xherdan Shaqiri yayin da yake kusan mita 30 daga kwallon Chelsea da kungiyarsa ke bin ta 1-0.
rows.reference: Sturridge ya karɓi wani turo ƙwallo daga Xherdan Shaqiri kusan yadina 30 a waje daga cin Chelsea tare da ‘yan ƙungiyarsa da suke biye ci 1 da 0.

rows.output: Ya taɓa ƙwallon zuwa hagunsa kafin ya zubar da harbi zuwa kusurwar nesa.
rows.reference: Ya taɓa ƙwallon zuwa hagun ɗinsa kafin ya yi wani bugu zuwa matsaya mai nisa.

rows.output: Ƙoƙarin ya yi tsalle a sama da akwatin yayin da yake yawo zuwa kusurwar hagu ta sama ta raga.
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarin ya ɗagu sama da akwatin inda ya gangara zuwa saman kusurwar dama na ragar.

rows.output: Kwallon ta fadi a kan Kepa Arrizabalaga mai tsalle da kuma shiga cikin raga.
rows.reference: Daga ƙarshe ƙwallon ta faɗo a saman Kepa Arrizabalaga mai tsalle inda kuma ta faɗa cikin ragar.

rows.output: "Kawai yana ƙoƙarin shiga wannan matsayi, don samun ƙwallon kuma 'yan wasa kamar Shaq koyaushe suna wasa da ita gaba gwargwadon yiwuwa, don haka kawai na yi ƙoƙarin ƙirƙirar lokaci mai yawa a gare ni gwargwadon yiwuwa," Sturridge ya gaya wa LiverpoolFC.com.
rows.reference: Sturridge ya faɗa a LiverpoolFC.com cewa “Kawai wani ƙoƙari ne na shiga wannan wurin, na samun ƙwallon kuma ‘yan wasa kamar Shaq koyaushe wasa suke yi a gaba yadda zai yiwu, don haka na yi kawai ƙoƙari ne na ƙirƙira wa kaina wani lokaci yadda zai yiwu.”

rows.output: "Na ga Kante yana zuwa sai na ɗauki taɓawa ɗaya kuma ban yi tunanin hakan ba sosai kuma kawai na ɗauki harbin."
rows.reference: “Na ga Kante yana zuwa kuma ya taɓa sau ɗaya kuma ban yi tunani game da shi sosai ba don haka sai na yi bugun kawai.”

rows.output: Chelsea ta jagoranci 1-0 a lokacin hutun rabin lokaci bayan da ta ci a mintuna 25 da Eden Hazard, ɗan wasan Belgium ya ci.
rows.reference: Chelsea ita ce a gaba da ci 1 da 0 a farkon rabin lokaci bayan ta sami wani ci a cikin minti na 25 daga tauraron Belgium Eden Hazard.

rows.output: Dan wasan Blues ya yi wani kwallon ya dawo da ita ga Mateo Kovacic a wannan wasan, kafin ya juyar da kansa kusa da tsakiyar filin wasa ya yi gudu zuwa rabin Liverpool.
rows.reference: Ɗan wasa mai kai hari na Blues ya sake miƙa ƙwallo zuwa ga Mateo Kovacic a wasan, kafin ya ruga zuwa tsakiyar filin da kuma dira a cikin rabin Liverpool ɗin.

rows.output: Kovacic ya yi sauri ya ba da kai da kuma komawa a tsakiyar filin wasa.
rows.reference: Nan da nan kuna Kovacic ya yi wata miƙawa ya ruga a tsakiyar filin.

rows.output: Sannan ya harba kwallo mai kyau, yana jagorantar Hazard zuwa cikin akwatin.
rows.reference: Sa’an nan sai ya yi wani kyakkyawan buga ƙwallon, inda ya tura Hazard cikin akwatin.

rows.output: Hazard ya zarce tsaron kuma ya sanya kwallonsa a cikin raga mai nisa, inda ya zura kwallo da kafarsa ta hagu a kan Liverpool's Alisson Becker.
rows.reference: Hazard ya wuce masu tsaron gida kuma ya gama zuwa matsayar raga mai nisa da sauri da wata ƙafar hagun inda ya wuce Alisson Becker na Liverpool.

rows.output: Liverpool ta yi fafatawa da Napoli a matakin rukuni na gasar zakarun Turai a karfe 3 na rana a ranar Laraba a filin wasa na San Paolo a Naples, Italiya.
rows.reference: Liverpool ta yi yaki da Napoli a cikin matakin gungu na Zakarun Kalubalen da karfe 3 na yamma a ranar Laraba a Stadio San Paolo da ke cikin Naples, Italiya.

rows.output: Chelsea za ta kara da Videoton a gasar cin kofin Europa a karfe 3 na rana a ranar Alhamis a Landan.

rows.output: An samu mutuwar mutane 832 a cikin tsunami da ya afku a Indonesia
rows.reference: An sami ƙarin mutuwa a tsunami na Indonesiya zuwa 832

rows.output: An samu asarar rayuka a cikin girgizar kasa da tsunami a Indonesia ya kai 832, a cewar hukumar bala'i ta kasar a safiyar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Ƙididdigar mutuwar a girgizar ƙasar ta Indonesiyan ya haura zuwa 832, inji hukumar kula da bala’i ta ƙasar a farkon ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: An ruwaito cewa mutane da yawa sun makale a cikin tarkacen gine-gine da suka fadi sakamakon girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.5 da ta afku a ranar Juma'a, wadda ta haifar da igiyoyin ruwa har zuwa tsayin ƙafa 20, a cewar mai magana da yawun hukumar Sutopo Purwo Nugroho a wani taro na manema labarai.
rows.reference: Abin ya ritsa da mutane masu yawa a cikin burbushin gine-gine da girgizar ƙasar mai ƙarfi na 7.5 ta rusa wadda ta auku ranar Juma’a da kuma ta jawo tashin jijiyoyin ruwa har tsawon taku 20, inji mai magana da yawun hukumar Sutopo Purwo Nugroho a lokacin da yake bayani a taron manema labarai.

rows.output: Birnin Palu, wanda ya fi mutane 380,000, ya cika da tarkace daga gidajen da suka ruguje.
rows.reference: Birnin Palu, mai mutane fiye da 380,000, ka kasance da ɓaraƙuzan rusassun gine-gine birjit.

rows.output: An kama mutum mai shekaru 32 a kan zargin kisan gilla bayan an yi wa wata mata kisan gilla
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun kama mutum, mai shekaru 32, a kan tuhuma bayan kashe mata ta hanyar caka mata wuƙa

rows.output: An fara bincike kan kisan gilla bayan an samu gawar wata mata a Birkenhead, Merseyside a safiyar yau.
rows.reference: An ƙaddamar da wani bincike bayan an sami gawar wata mata a cikin Birkenhead, Merseyside wannan safiyar.

rows.output: An gano wani mutum mai shekaru 44 a cikin mintuna 7.55 na safe da raunuka da suka yi masa a Grayson Mews a kan John Street, inda aka kama wani mutum mai shekaru 32 da laifi a kan zargin kisan kai.
rows.reference: An sami mai shekaru 44 ne da karfe 7:55 na safe da raunuka na caka wuka a kan Grayson Mews da ke kan Titin John, tare da kama wani mutum mai shekaru 32 da ake tuhuma da kisan.

rows.output: Jami'an 'yan sanda sun bukaci mutane a yankin da suka ga ko ji wani abu da ya shafe su.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun nemi mutane da ke yankin da suka gani ko kuma suka ji wani abu da su garzayo.

rows.output: Jami'in bincike Brian O'Hagan ya ce: 'Binciken yana cikin matakan farko amma zan yi kira ga duk wanda yake cikin yankin John Street a Birkenhead wanda ya ga ko ya ji wani abu mai shakku ya tuntuɓe mu.
rows.reference: Sufeto Mai Bincike Brian O'Hagan ya ce: ‘Binciken yana matakan farko-farko ne amma zan yi kira ga duk wanda ke kewayen Layin John a Birkenhead wanda ya gani ko kuma ya ji wani abu da bai yarda da shi ba da ya tuntuɓe mu.

rows.output: Haka kuma zan yi kira ga duk wanda ya ga wani abu, musamman direbobin mota, wanda zai iya daukar wani abu a kan dashcam, ya tuntube mu domin zai iya samun bayanai masu matukar muhimmanci ga bincike namu.
rows.reference: Har ila yau zan sake kira ga kowa, musamman direbobin tasi, waɗanda ƙila sun ɗauki hoto a kyamarar da ke cikin gaban mota da su tuntuɓe mu don ba mamaki ƙila suna da bayani da ke da muhimmanci ga bincikenmu.'

rows.output: Wani jami'in 'yan sanda ya tabbatar da cewa matar da aka samu gawarta tana cikin garin Birkenhead kuma an samu ta a cikin wani gida.
rows.reference: Wani mai magana da yawun ‘yan sanda ya tabbatar da cewa matar da aka sami gawar tata ‘yar yankin na Birkenhead ne kuma an same ta ne a cikin wani gini.

rows.output: Yau da safe, abokai da suke ganin suna san matar sun iso wurin don tambayar inda aka samu ta da safe.
rows.reference: Yau da rana abokai waɗanda suka yi imani sun san matar sun je wurin da abin ya faru don yin tambayoyi game da inda aka same ta wannan safiyar.

rows.output: Ana ci gaba da bincike a matsayin da 'yan sanda suka ce suna cikin tsarin sanar da dangi na gaba.
rows.reference: Ana ci gaba da bincike-bincike kamar yadda ‘yan sanda suke cewa suna cikin shirin gaya wa ‘yan uwan wadda abin ya shafa.

rows.output: Wani direban taksi da ke zaune a Grayson Mews ya yi yunkurin komawa gidan sa, amma ‘yan sanda sun gaya masa cewa babu wanda aka ba izinin shiga ko fitowa daga ginin.
rows.reference: Wani direban tasi da ke zaune a Grayson Mews ya yi ƙoƙarin ya koma cikin gidansa amma ‘yan sanda sun gaya masa cewa ba a yarda wani ya shiga ciki ko fita daga ginin ba.

rows.output: Ya yi shuru lokacin da ya gano abin da ya faru.
rows.reference: Ya gagara magana a lokacin da ya gano abin da ya faru.

rows.output: Mazauna yanzu ana gaya musu cewa za a jira har tsawon sa'o'i kafin a bar su su dawo.
rows.reference: An gaya wa mazaunan cewa zai ɗauki sa’o’i kafin a bari su koma ciki.

rows.output: Wani jami'in 'yan sanda ya ji yana gaya wa wani mutum cewa dukkan yankin yanzu ana daukarsa a matsayin wurin aikata laifi.
rows.reference: An ji wani jami’in ‘yan sanda yana gaya wa wani mutum cewa ana ɗaukan gaba ɗaya wurin a matsayin wani wuri da aka aikata laifi.

rows.output: Wata mata ta bayyana a wurin cikin hawaye.

rows.output: Tana ci gaba da maimaitawa 'abu ne mai muni sosai'.

rows.output: Da misalin karfe 2 na rana, an samu motocin ‘yan sanda biyu a cikin katangar, tare da wata mota a waje.
rows.reference: Da karfe 2 na rana motoci guda biyu na ‘yan sanda sun killece tare da wata babbar mota guda kawai a waje.

rows.output: Wasu jami'ai ne suka tsaya a cikin katangar da ke kewaye da ginin.
rows.reference: Wasu jami’an sun tsaya a cikin killecewar suna duba yanki na gidajen.

rows.output: Kowa da ke da bayanai ana buƙatar ya aika da saƙo ga @MerPolCC, ya kira 101, ko ya tuntuɓi Crimestoppers a cikin sirri a 0800 555 111, yana ambaton log 247 na 30 ga Satumba.

rows.output: An yi wa ginshiƙin majalisar Cromwell sabon abu da aka yi wa 'sake fasalin tarihi'
rows.reference: Mutum-mutumi na Majalisar Dokoki ta Cromwell ta zama abin da ake tunawa na baya-bayan nan da ya faɗa ‘rikicin sake rubuta tarihi’

rows.output: Zai zama adalci na adabi ga mugunyar da ya yi wa al'adun Ingilishi da abubuwan ibada da mabiyan sa na masu tsattsauran ra'ayi suka yi.
rows.reference: Kore shin zai zama sakamakon alhaki don irin salon rushe wuraren tarihi, al’ada da addini na Ingila kamar na ‘yan Taliban yadda mabiyansa masu tsatstsauran ra’ayi suka yi.

rows.output: Amma kungiyar Cromwell ta bayyana shawarar Mr. Crick a matsayin "hauka" da "kokarin sake rubuta tarihi."
rows.reference: Amma Al’ummar Cromwell sun bayyana shawarar ta Mista Crick a matsayin “wauta” da “ƙoƙari na sake rubuta tarihi.”

rows.output: John Goldsmith, shugaban kungiyar Cromwell Society, ya ce: "Abu ne mai yiwuwa a cikin muhawara ta yanzu game da cire hotuna cewa jikin Oliver Cromwell a waje da fadar Westminster zai zama manufa."
rows.reference: John Goldsmith, shugaban Al’ummar Cromwell, ya ce: “Ba za a iya gujewa a cikin mahawarar da ake yi yanzu ba game da cire mutum-mutumi cewa surar Oliver Cromwell a wajen Fadar Westminster za ta zama wani abin da ake hari.

rows.output: Maganar kisan karen da aka yi a lokacin yaƙin basasar Ingilishi ba a umarce shi ba, kuma ba a yi shi ba da Cromwell.
rows.reference: Yin hari a kan fitattun abubuwa na yaƙe-yaƙen basasar Ingila ba Cromwell na ba da oda a yi ko ya aikata ba.

rows.output: Wataƙila an yi wa Cromwell da ba daidai ba a yi wa aikinsa na kakansa Thomas a ƙarni na baya.
rows.reference: Watakila abu mummunan da za a ga bayan Cromwell a kansa shi ne ayyukan da kakansa Thomas ya yi a cikin ƙarni da ya wuce.

rows.output: Wani babban zane na Sir William Hamo Thorneycroft na Cromwell yana nuna ra'ayin karni na 19 da kuma wani bangare na tarihin tarihin wani mutum da da yawa ke ganin har yanzu yana da darajar murna.
rows.reference: Akwai babbar bayani game da Cromwell na Sa William Hamo Thorneycroft da ke zama hujjar ra’ayi na karni na 19 wanda kuma ɓangare na ilimin bayanan tarihin na wani sananne wanda mafi yawa suka yi imani har yanzu ya kamata a yi murna a kansa.

rows.output: Mr Goldsmith ya gaya wa The Sunday Telegraph: "Cromwell ana ganin shi da yawa, wataƙila fiye da ƙarnuka na 19 fiye da yau, a matsayin mai kare majalisar dokoki daga matsin lamba daga waje, a cikin yanayin sa ba shi da wani abu.
rows.reference: Mista Goldsmith ya faɗa a jaridar The Sunday Telegraph: “Mutane da yawa suna ɗaukan Cromwell, watakila sosai a shekarun karshe na karni na 19 fiye da yau, a matsayin mai kare majalisar dokoki daga matsi na waje, a cikin rikicin ba makawa da mulkin sarauta.

rows.output: Shin wannan wani cikakken wani wani abu ne na gaskiya, batun muhawara na tarihi ne mai ci gaba.
rows.reference: Ko wancan bayanin zai zama wani abu gaba ɗaya daidai ya zama batun na ci gaba da mahawara ta fuskar tarihi.

rows.output: Abin da ya tabbas shi ne cewa rikicin na tsakiyar karni na 17 ya tsara ci gaban da ya biyo baya na kasar mu, kuma Cromwell mutum ne mai iya ganewa wanda ke wakiltar daya daga cikin rabe-raben da ke cikin wannan rikici.
rows.reference: Abin da ke da tabbaci shi ne rikicin na tsakiyar ƙarni na 17 ya gyara ci gaba na ƙasarmu da aka samu daga baya, kuma Cromwell wani mutum ne sananne da aka sani wanda ke wakiltar sashe ɗaya na wancan rikicin.

rows.output: Sakamakon da ya samu a matsayin Mai Kare Mulki ma ya cancanci a yi murna da kuma tunawa da shi."
rows.reference: Abubuwan da ya cimma a matsayin Lord Protector ya kuma kamata a yi bikinsu da tunawa da su.”

rows.output: Alade mai kisa ya kashe manomi na kasar Sin

rows.output: Wani manomi ya samu raunuka daga alade a kasuwar da ke kudu maso yammacin kasar Sin, a cewar rahotannin kafofin yammaci.
rows.reference: Wani alade ya kai hari da kuma kashe wani manomi a cikin wata kasuwa da ke cikin kudu-maso-yamma na China, a cewar rahotanni daga kafofin watsa labarai na gida.

rows.output: Mutumin, wanda aka san shi da sunan mahaifinsa "Yuan," an samu gawarsa da jijiyoyin jijiya, an rufe shi da jini kusa da wani kantin sayar da kayan abinci a Liupanshui a lardin Guizhou, a cewar jaridar South China Morning Post a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: An gano mutumin kawai da sunan laƙabinsa na "Yuan," wanda aka samu a mace tare da jijiyar wuya a yanke, duk jini ya rufe kusa da wani sty a kasuwar da ke cikin Liupanshui a cikin lardin Guizhou province, kamar yadda jaridar South China Morning Post ta kawo rahoto.

rows.output: Manomin alade yana shiryawa don allurar rigakafi ga aladu a gonar alade a ranar 30 ga Mayu, 2005 a Xining na Qinghai, Sin.
rows.reference: Wani manomin alade ya shirya yin allura ga aladu a ɗakin kiwon aladu a ranar 30 ga Mayu, 2005 a cikin Xining da Lardin Qinghai, China.

rows.output: Ya yi tuntuɓe da kawunsa daga lardi mai makwabtaka da Yunnan a ranar Laraba domin sayar da alade 15 a kasuwar.
rows.reference: An ba da rahoton cewa ya yi bulaguro ne da ɗan uwansa daga makwaɓcin lardin Yunnan a ranar Laraba don sayar da aladu 15 a kasuwar.

rows.output: Washe gari, wani kawunsa ya samu ya mutu, ya kuma gano kofa a cikin gidan alade na makwabta a bude.
rows.reference: Da safiyar washegari, ɗan uwan nasa ya same a mace, kuma ya ga wata ƙofa zuwa ga wani makwaɓcin wurin aladu na sty a buɗe.

rows.output: Ya ce a cikin gidan alade akwai alade namiji mai girma da jini a bakinsa.
rows.reference: Ya ce a cikin sty ɗin an sami wani babban alade namiji da jini a kan bakinsa.

rows.output: An tabbatar da binciken likita cewa alade mai nauyin kilo 550 ya kashe manomi, a cewar rahoton.
rows.reference: Wani binciken kimiyya na abin da ya faru ya tabbatar da cewa aladen mai nauyi 550 ya murƙushe manomin har lahira, a cewar rahoton.

rows.output: "Ƙanwata ƙafafunta suna da jini kuma sun lalace," kawunta, wanda aka ambata da sunan "Wu," ya ce, kamar yadda jaridar Guiyang Evening News ta ruwaito.

rows.reference: An kama Dyteon Simpson, mai shekaru 20 kuma an kai shi kurkuku a kan wata tuhumar kisa mai mataki na biyu, inji Ma’aikatar ‘Yan Sandan Baton Rouge.

rows.output: Jami'an sun fitar da bidiyo na arangama tsakanin Sims da Simpson, kuma 'yan sanda sun ce Sims ya rasa gilashin sa a lokacin arangamar.
rows.reference: Jami’ai sun saki bidiyo na takardamar tsakanin Sims da Simpson, kuma ‘yan sanda sun ce Sims ya rasa gilashinsa a lokacin fadan.

rows.output: An dawo da gilashin daga wurin da aka aikata laifin, kuma 'yan sanda sun ce sun sami DNA na Simpson a kansa, a cewar CBS ta WAFB.
rows.reference: ‘Yan sanda sun sami gilashin daga wurin da aka aikata laifin inda suka kuma ce sun sami abin halittar DNA na Simpson a kansu, kamar yadda rahoton WAFB mai alaƙa da CBS ya faɗa.

rows.output: Bayan an yi wa Simpson tambayoyi, ‘yan sanda sun ce ya amince da kashe Wayde.
rows.reference: Bayan tambayan Simpson, ‘yan sanda sun ce ya amsa laifi na mummunan harbin Wayde.

rows.output: An saita belin sa a kan dala 350,000, a cewar mai ba da labarai.
rows.reference: An sa kuɗin belinsa a dala 350,000, a cewar rahoton Advocate.

rows.output: Ofishin Coroner na East Baton Rouge Parish ya fitar da rahoton farko a ranar Juma'a, yana mai cewa dalilin mutuwar shi ne raunukan bindiga a cikin kaina zuwa wuyansa.
rows.reference: Ofishin Mai Binciken a kan Musabbabin Kisa na Baton Rouge ta Gabas ya saki wani rahoton farko ranar Jumu’a, yana cewa musabbabin mutuwar wani harbin bindiga ne zuwa ga ka da ya wuce cikin wuya.

rows.output: Sashen ya yi godiya ga rundunar 'yan sanda ta Louisiana, rundunar 'yan sanda ta Louisiana, jami'ar kudu maso gabas, da 'yan kasa na yankin da suka taimaka wajen bincike wanda ya kai ga kame.
rows.reference: Ma’aikatar ta yabi jami’an ‘yan sanda na Jihar Louisiana masu aikin kama wanda ya gudu, da ɗakin ‘yan sanda na gwajin kimiyyar aikata lafi na jihar, da ‘yan sandan Jami’ar Kudanci da mazauna yanki don taimakawa a binciken da ya kai ga kamen.

rows.output: Jami'in wasan motsa jiki na LSU Joe Alleva ya yaba wa hukumar 'yan sanda ta yankin bisa "jajircewarta da kuma bin adalci."
rows.reference: Daraktan wasan tsalle-tsalle na LSU Joe Alleva ya gode wa ma’aikatan doka na yankin don irin aikinsu na “jajircewa da ganin an yi adalci.”

rows.reference: Toka da ke fesuwa daga babban dutsi mai amon wuta na Popocatepetl ta isa makwaɓta na kudancin babban birnin Mexico.

rows.output: Cibiyar Kula da Haddura ta yi gargadi ga 'yan ƙasar Mexico a ranar Asabar da su kiyaye tsaunin bayan da aka samu karuwar aikinta da kuma samun fitar da iskar gas da toka 183 cikin sa'o'i 24.
rows.reference: Cibiyar Hana Haɗura ta Ƙasa ta gargaɗi ‘yan Mexico a ranar Asabar kar su kusanci dutsin bayan abin ya kai koli a farfashewar inda kuma a ka yi rijistar fitar da hayaƙi na iskar gas 183 da kuma toka ta fiye da sa’o’i 24.

rows.output: Cibiyar tana lura da motsi da girgizar ƙasa da yawa.
rows.reference: Cibiyar tana kula da cidodi da girgize-girgizen ƙasa.

rows.output: Hotuna a shafukan sada zumunta sun nuna yadda ƙananan layukan ash ke rufe tagogin motoci a unguwanni na birnin Mexico kamar Xochimilco.
rows.reference: Hotuna a hanyar sadarwa ta zumunta sun nuna mashimfiɗu marassa kauri na toka suna danƙare a jikin gilasan mota a cikin makwaɓta na Birnin Mexico kamar su Xochimilco.

rows.output: Masana ilimin ƙasa sun lura da karuwar aikace-aikacen a kan wutar lantarkin da ke da nisa mil 45 (kilomita 72) kudu maso gabas da babban birnin kasar tun bayan girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfi 7.1 da ta afku a tsakiyar Mexico a watan Satumba 2017.
rows.reference: Masana kimiyyar yanayi sun lura da wani karin aiki a dutsin da ke zaune a mil 45 (kilomita 72) kudu-maso-gabas na babban birnin tun daga wata girgizar kasa da aka yi mai girman 7.1 da ta raguza tsakiyar Mexico a Satumba 2017.

rows.output: Tsaunin da ake kira "Don Goyo" ya kasance mai aiki tun 1994.
rows.reference: Dutsi mai amon wutar da ake kira "Don Goyo" ya daɗe yana tashi tun 1994.

rows.output: Rundunar 'yan sanda ta yi artabu da masu fafutukar 'yanci na Catalan a gaba da ranar da aka shirya zaɓen 'yanci.
rows.reference: ’Yan sanda sun yi arangama da masu neman ɓallewa na Catalan kafin zagayowar bikin neman ‘yanci

rows.output: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan da masu goyon bayan 'yancin kai suka yi taɓo da 'yan sanda, yayin da dubban mutane suka shiga zanga-zangar da ta yi kaca-kaca don murnar ranar farko da ta gabata a kan zaben rabe-raben da ya raba kan raba kan Catalonia.
rows.reference: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan masu zanga-zangar nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi fito-na-fito tare da ‘yan sandan kwantar da tarzoma, kuma kamar yadda dubun-dubata suka shiga zanga-zanga ta adawa da juna don bikin zagayowar ranar kaɗa kuri’a da ta raba Catalonia a kan ɓallewa.

rows.output: Wani gungun masu kunshe da fatar ido masu goyon bayan 'yanci sun yi murabus da 'yan sanda masu tsauri, inda suka jefa su da ƙwai da kuma fenti, wanda ya haifar da duhu mai duhu a kan tituna da a da ake cike da masu yawon bude ido.
rows.reference: Wani gungu masu goyon bayan ɓallewar da suka rufe idanuwansu da ‘yan sanda suka riƙe sun jefe su da koyaye da kuma watsa musu fentin foda, inda suka ƙirƙiri wasu gajimare mai duhu a cikin titunan da yawanci sukan cika maƙil da ‘yan yawon shaƙatawa.

rows.output: An yi taɓaɓɓen tashin hankali a ranar da ta gabata, inda ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da sanduna don sarrafawa.
rows.reference: Faɗace-faɗace sun ɓarke a ranar daga baya inda ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da kulaƙensu don hana faɗan.

rows.output: A cikin sa'o'i da dama, ƙungiyoyin masu fafutukar 'yanci sun yi ihu "Baiwar mantawa, ba a gafartawa" a kan masu fafutukar hadin kai suna ihu, "Rayuwa ta Spain."
rows.reference: Har fiye da tsawon sa’o’i masu yawa gungu-gungun masu goyon bayan ɓallewar suna amshi “Babu mantuwa, babu yafiya” sun yi rikici da masu zanga-zanga ‘yan son haɗewa suna ihu, Allah ya ja kwanan Spain.”

rows.output: Mutanu goma sha hudu sun samu kulawar asibiti saboda raunukan da suka samu a lokacin zanga-zangar, a cewar kafafen yada labarai na gida.
rows.reference: An yi magani a mutane goma sha huɗu don ƙananan raunuka da suka ji a zanga-zangogi, kamar yadda kafofin watsa labarai na gida suka ba da rahoto.

rows.output: Tashe-tashen hankali sun ci gaba da kasancewa a yankin da ke son 'yanci shekara guda bayan ranar 1 ga Oktoba, wanda aka yi watsi da shi a matsayin na doka a Madrid amma aka yi bikin ta 'yan Catalunya masu nema 'yanci.
rows.reference: Har yanzu da tashin hankali sosai a lardin da ya sa ‘yanci a zuciyarsa shekara ɗaya bayan zaɓen raba gardama na 1 ga Oktoba wanda Madrid ke ɗauka ba ya bisa doka amma ‘yan Catalan masu neman ɓallewa ke ta yin murna da shi.

rows.output: Masu jefa kuri'a sun zabi a fili su zama 'yancin kai, duk da cewa an samu karancin fitowar masu jefa kuri'a, inda masu adawa da rabuwa da su suka fi son kaucewa zaben.
rows.reference: Masu jefa kuri’ar sun yi zaɓe sosai inda suka zaɓi ‘yanci kodayake ba a fito sosai ba inda waɗanda ba sa son ɓallewa suka ƙauracewa zaɓen.

rows.output: A cikin shekarar da ta gabata, sama da mutane 1000 ne suka ji rauni bayan 'yan sanda sun yi yunkurin hana zaben a rumfunan zaɓe a yankin, a cikin tashin hankali.
rows.reference: A cewar hukumomin Catalan an aƙalla raunata mutane 1000 ne shekarar da ta wuce bayan ‘yan sanda sun yi ƙoƙarin su tsaida kaɗa kuri’ar da ake yi a wuraren jefa kuri’ar a dukkan faɗin lardin a cikin gumurzun tashin hankali.

rows.output: Ƙungiyoyin da ke goyon bayan 'yanci sun yi sansani a daren Juma'a don hana zanga-zangar goyon bayan 'yan sanda na kasa.
rows.reference: Gungu-gungu na masu nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi dandazo waje da dare suna goyon baya na ‘yan sandan ƙasa.

rows.output: An yi ta cece-ku-ce, amma an tilasta musu su dauko wani sabon hanya.
rows.reference: Zanga-zangar ta ci gaba amma an tilasta mata ɗaukan wata hanya daban.

rows.output: Narcis Termes, mai shekaru 68, mai aikin lantarki da ke halartar zanga-zangar neman 'yanci tare da matarsa, ya ce bai yi tsammanin samun 'yanci ga Catalonia ba.
rows.reference: Narcis Termes, mai shekaru 68, wani latirisha da ke halartar zanga-zangar ‘yan neman ɓallewar tare da matarsa ya ce ba ya kuma fatan ganin yiwuwar Catalonia ta sami ‘yanci.

rows.output: "Shekarar da ta gabata mun rayu ta cikin ɗaya daga cikin mafi kyawun lokutanmu.
rows.reference: “Shekarar da ta wuce mun rayu a cikin ɗaya daga cikin lokacinmu mafi kyau.

rows.output: Na kalli iyayena suna kuka da farin ciki saboda suna da damar kada kuri'a amma yanzu mun makale," ya ce.
rows.reference: Na kalli iyayena suna kukan murna saboda damar jefa kuri’a amma yanzu mun tsaya ciki,” inji shi.

rows.output: Duk da cewa sun samu nasara mai muhimmanci, ko da a kan iyaka, a zaben yankin a watan Disamba na baya, jam'iyyun 'yanci na Catalan sun yi kokawa wajen ci gaba da samun karfin guiwa a wannan shekara, yayin da wasu daga cikin manyan shuwagabanninsu ke tsoron tsoro a waje ko kuma a tsare a jiran shari'a bisa zarginsu da shiryawa da gudanar da zaben da kuma shelar 'yanci.
rows.reference: Duk da gudanar da wata muhimmiyar nasara ko da tsukekkiya ce a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan yankin a Disamba da ta wuce, jam’iyyun da ke goyon bayan ‘yanci na Catalan sun yi gwagwarmaya don su ci gaba da hazaƙar wannan shekarar tare da yawancin sanannun fitattun shugabanninsu ko dai sun tafi neman mafakar da suka sa kansu ko an kame su suna jiran shari’a don rawarsu da suka taka a cikin shirya zaɓen raba gardamar da furuci na ‘yanci da suka yi daga baya.

rows.output: Joan Puig, mai shekaru 42 mai aikin mota, wanda ke rubuta zanga-zangar goyon bayan ‘yan sanda a wayarsa, ya ce rikicin ya tsananta ne ta hanyar ‘yan siyasa a bangarorin biyun.
rows.reference: Joan Puig, wani makanike mai shekaru 42 da ke daukan zanga-zanga a cikin goyon baya na ‘yan sanda a kan tarho dinsa, ya ce rikicin ya sami ruruwa ne daga ‘yan siyasa da ke dukkan bangarorin.

rows.output: "Yana ƙara tsananta," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Yana ƙara ƙazanta sosai,” inji shi.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, daya daga cikin manyan shuwagabannin Catalonia tara da ake tsare da su tun karshen shekarar da ta gabata, ya bayyana cewa zai tsallake zaben Majalisar Tarayyar Turai a shekarar mai zuwa.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, ɗaya daga shugabanni tara na Catalan da ke tsare kafin a fara shari’a tun ƙarshen shekarar da ta wuce, ya sanar cewa zai tsaya zaɓuɓɓukan Majalisar Dokoki ta Turai a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.output: "Tsayawa takarar zaben Turai hanya ce mafi kyau ta nuna adawa da raguwar dabi'un dimokuradiyya da kuma zalunci da gwamnatin Spain ta nuna," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Tsayawa a matsayin wani ɗan takara don zaɓuɓɓukan Turai shi ne hanya mafi kyau ta kin koma baya a kimomin dimokuraɗiyya da zalunci da muka gani daga gwamnatin Spain,” inji shi.

rows.output: Londonderry: An kama mutane bayan an yi wa gidan da mota ta yi kutsawa

rows.output: Lamarin ya faru ne a Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da misalin karfe 19:30 na safe.

rows.output: Wani abu mai kumbura na iya harbin motar a wani lokaci.

rows.output: Menga ya ci gaba da ba Livingston nasara 1-0 a kan Rangers

rows.output: Dolly Menga ta samu kwallonta ta farko ga Livingston ta samu nasara

rows.output: An yi wa Livingston ta'aziyya, ta firgita Rangers, ta sanya Steven Gerrard ya samu rashin nasara na biyu a wasanni 18 da ya yi a matsayin manajan kulob din Ibrox.
rows.reference: Livingston da aka ƙara wa girma ta ba da mamaki ga Rangers inda ta ajiye Steven Gerrard kawai zuwa ga cinsa da aka yi karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 a matsayinsa na manaja na kulob ɗin Ibrox.

rows.output: Kwallon da Dolly Menga ta yi ta nuna bambanci, yayin da Gary Holt's side ta yi da Hibernian a matsayi na biyu.
rows.reference: Harin da Dolly Menga ya yi ya kasance abin da kawo bambanci saboda ɓangaren Gary Holt ya motsa lebur tare da Hibernian a cikin mataki na biyu.

rows.output: Kungiyar Gerrard har yanzu ba ta samu nasara a wani gida ba a gasar Premier a wannan kakar, kuma za ta kara da Hearts, wanda suke kan gaba da maki takwas, a ranar Lahadi mai zuwa.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren Gerrard yana nan ba tare da wata nasara da zai ta fi da ita ba a cikin wasan Premiership ɗin wannan lokacin kuma zai fuskanci Leaders Hearts, waɗanda suke bi da digo takwas, Lahadi mai zuwa.

rows.output: Kafin haka, Rangers ta karbi bakuncin Rapid Vienna a gasar cin kofin Turai a ranar Alhamis.
rows.reference: Kafin nan, Rangers sun karɓi Rapid Vienna a cikin wasan Europa League a ranar Alhamis.

rows.output: Livingston, a halin yanzu, sun tsawaita rashin cin nasara a rukuninsu zuwa wasanni shida, inda kocin kungiyar Holt bai yi rashin nasara ba tun bayan da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miler a watan da ya gabata.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake ciki hakan, Livinsgton, sun kara matsayinsu na ba wanda ya doke su a cikin shiyyar zuwa wasanni shida, tare da shugaban horar da wasa Holt har yanzu don ɗanɗana dokewa tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miler wata da ya wuce.

rows.output: Livingston sun rasa damammaki a kan baƙi masu tsauri
rows.reference: Livingston sun rasa damammaki a kan maziyartansu da ba su dama

rows.output: Tawagar Holt ta kamata ta kasance a gaba tun da dadewa kafin ta ci, saboda salon su na kai hari ya haifar da matsaloli da yawa ga Rangers.
rows.reference: Ya kamata a ce ƙungiyar Holt suna gaba ne kafin su ci, tare da fuskantar tasu wanda ke haifar wa Rangers matsaloli iri-iri.

rows.output: Scott Robinson ya yi nasara, amma ya ja kwallonsa a fatar raga, sannan Alan Lithgow ya yi kokari ya buga kwallonsa a gefen raga bayan ya yi tsalle ya hadu da kwallon Craig Halkett a fatar raga.
rows.reference: Scott Robinson ya shige ciki amma ya ja ƙoƙarinsa ta gaban fuska ta cin nasara, shi ke nan Alan Lithgow kawai zai iya fuskantar da ƙoƙarinsa bayan yin ƙasa don haɗuwa da bugu da ka na cin Craig Halkett.

rows.output: Masu masaukin baki sun yi farin ciki da barin Rangers su yi wasa a gaban su, suna sane da cewa za su iya damun baƙi a lokacin da za a yi wasan.
rows.reference: Masu saukan bakin sun yarda su bar Rangers su buga wasa a gabansu, suna sane da cewa za su iya wahalar da masu ziyarar a jerin ɗaiɗaiku.

rows.output: Kuma haka ne aka samu muƙamin da ya yi muhimmanci.
rows.reference: Kuma wancan shi ne yadda ci mai muhimmancin ya gudana.

rows.output: Rangers ta yi wa 'yan wasa kyauta, kuma Livingston sun yi aiki, Declan Gallagher da Robinson sun hada kai don saita Menga, wanda ya dauko kuma ya ci a tsakiyar raga.
rows.reference: Rangers sun amince da bugun da ba tarewa kuma Livingston suka yi aiki da wata dama, Declan Gallagher da Robinson suka haɗe suka tsara Menga, wanda ya taɓa da kuma ci daga tsakiya ta akwatin.

rows.output: A wannan mataki, Rangers sun mamaye mallakin ammanar, amma sun sami tsaron gida mai wahala da kuma mai tsaron gida Liam Kelly ba a damu da shi sosai.
rows.reference: A wannan mataki, Rangers ta mamaye riƙe ƙwallo amma ta sami tsaron gidan ba zai ba da damar wucewa ba kuma mai kama ƙwallo Liam Kelly kuma gaba ɗaya bai damu ba.

rows.output: Wannan tsarin ya ci gaba zuwa rabin na biyu, kodayake Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wa Kelly ya yi tsalle.
rows.reference: Wannan yanayi ya ci gaba har rabi na biyu, kodayake Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wani ceto daga Kelly.

rows.output: An hana Scott Pittman daga ƙafafun mai tsaron gida na Rangers Allan McGregor, kuma Lithgow ya yi kuskure daga wata kafa ta Livingston.
rows.reference: Scott Pittman bai samu dama ba daga ƙafa ta mai kama ƙwallo na Rangers Allan McGregor kuma Lithgow ya buɗa sosai daga wani wasan da Livingston ya tsara.

rows.output: Kwallayen suna ci gaba da shiga cikin akwatin Livingston kuma ana ci gaba da share su, yayin da aka yi ikirarin biyu na haram - bayan kalubalen Halkett kan mai maye gurbin Glenn Middleton, da kuma daya don haramcin hannu - an yi watsi da su.
rows.reference: Sai kuma bugu ta ko’ina da suka riƙa zuwa cikin akwatin Livingston inda kuma a ci gaba da maganinsu, a yayin da aka samu bugu daga kai sai gola - bayan ƙalubalantar Halkett a kan maye gurbin Glenn Middleton, kuma ɗaya don taɓawa da hannu - inda aka ture gefe.

rows.output: Salon wasan su da kuma 'yan wasan su ba su canzawa sosai tun bayan dawowarsu gasar ta farko, amma babba ne ya kamata a ba da karramawar Holt kan yadda ya kara wa kungiyar kuzari tun lokacin da ya iso.
rows.reference: Irin salonsu na wasa da ma’aikata ya dan canza tun da dawowarsu zuwa saman matsayi, amma babban yabo ya kamata ya je ne ga Holt da irin hanyar da ya haɗa ƙungiyar tun zuwansa.

rows.output: Ya samu jarumai da yawa.

rows.output: Kyaftin Halkett ya yi girman kauri, yana jagorantar tsaron da ya yi kyau, yayin da Menga ya ci gaba da tsoratar da Connor Goldson da Joe Worrall a duk lokacin.

rows.output: Rangers ba su da ƙwazo, duk da haka.

rows.output: Aƙalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu, da yawa kuma aka yi musu fushi yayin da manyan igiyoyi suka yi ta shawagi a bakin teku, lokacin da wani babban girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afku a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesia, a cewar hukumomi a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Aƙalla an kashe mutane 384, da tafiya da wasu saboda igiyoyin ruwa masu girma sun fado a kan bakin teku, a lokacin da wata babbar girgizar ƙasa da tsunami suka afka a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesiya, injin hukumomi a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi ta jajircewa wajen gudanar da bikin a bakin teku a birnin Palu a ranar Juma'a, lokacin da igiyoyin ruwa masu tsayi kimanin mita shida (ƙafa 18) suka yi kaca-kaca a bakin teku a lokacin faduwar rana, inda suka kori mutane da yawa zuwa ga mutuwarsa, tare da lalata duk abin da ya shafe su.
rows.reference: Ɗaruruwan mutane suka taru don wani biki a kan teku na birnin Palu a ranar Juma’a a yayin da igiyoyin ruwan da suka mitoci shiɗa a sama (taku 18) suka afka bakin teku da dare, inda suka share da yawa suka mutu da lalata kowane abu da ke hanyar tasu.

rows.output: An binne tsunami bayan girgizar ƙasa mai girma 7.5.
rows.reference: Tsunamin ta biyo bayan wata girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfin 7 da ɗigo 5.

rows.output: "Yayin da barazanar tsunami ta taso jiya, mutane har yanzu suna yin ayyukan su a bakin teku kuma ba su gudu nan take ba, kuma sun zama wadanda suka sha wahala," in ji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar kasa ta Indonesia ta BNPB a wani taro a Jakarta.
rows.reference: “A yayin da barazanar tsunamin ta taso jiya, mutane a lokacin suna ayyukansu ne a kan bakin tekun kuma ba su gudu nan da nan ba inda suka zama waɗanda abin ya shafa,” inji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar rage haɗura ta Indonesiya ta BNPB a cikin wata gajeruwar ganawa da ‘yan jarida a cikin Jakarta.

rows.output: "Harin tsunami bai zo da kansa ba, ya ja motoci, katako, gidajen, ya bugi komai a ƙasa," in ji Nugroho, inda ya kara cewa tsunami ya yi tafiya a cikin teku mai fadi da sauri 800 kph (497 mph) kafin ya bugi bakin teku.
rows.reference: “Tsunamin tazo da kanta ne, ta jawo ƙananan motoci, katakwaye, gidaje, ta kuma bugi duk abin da ke kan ƙasa,” inji Nugroho, inda ya kara da cewa tsunami ta yi tafiya a faɗin buɗeɗɗen teku da gudu na kilomita 800 kowace sa’a (mil 497 kowace sa’a) kafin ta sauka a bakin tekun.

rows.output: Wasu mutane sun hau bishiyoyi don su tsere daga tsunami kuma suka tsira, ya ce.
rows.reference: Wasu mutanen sun hau bishiyoyi ne don tsira daga tsunami kuma sun rayu, inji shi.

rows.output: Kimanin mutane 16,700 an kai su sansanoni 24 a Palu.
rows.reference: An kwashe kusan mutane 16,700 zuwa cibiyoyi 24 da ke cikin Palu.

rows.output: Hotunan jiragen sama da hukumar bala'i ta fitar sun nuna cewa an lalata manyan gine-gine da shaguna, an murɗe gada da kuma rushewa, kuma an kewaye masallaci da ruwa.
rows.reference: Hotunan da aka ɗauka daga sama da hukumar haɗarin ta sake sun nuna gine-gine da shaguna a lalace, gadojin sun lankwashe da rushewa da wani masallaci ruwa ya kewaye shi.

rows.output: Garin bakin teku ya sake girgiza a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An ci gaba da samun girgize-girgize na baya da suka addabi birnin da ke kusa da tekun a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi jerin girgizar ƙasa a yankin da mutane miliyan 2.4 ke zama.
rows.reference: An ji girgize-girgizen ƙasa a jere a wani yanki mai mutane miliyan 2 da dubu ɗari 4.

rows.output: Hukumar Kula da Kimanta da Aiwatar da Fasahar (BPPT) ta Indonesia ta ce a cikin wata sanarwa cewa, makaman da aka saki a ranar Juma'a ta girgizar kasa ta girma kusan sau 200 fiye da karfin bam din atomic da aka jefa a Hiroshima a lokacin yakin duniya na biyu.
rows.reference: Hukumar Auna da Aiwatar da Fasaha ta Indonesiya (BPPT) a cikin wata sanarwa ta ce ƙarfi da babbar girgizar ƙasa ta sake a ranar Jumu’ar ya kai kusan sau 200 na ƙarfin bam na sinadarin atom da aka jefa a kan Hiroshima a cikin Yakin Duniya na Biyu.

rows.output: Yankunan birnin, wanda ke kusa da ƙarshen wani kogi mai tsawo, mai tsawo, na iya ƙara girma da girman tsunami, in ji ta.
rows.reference: Yanayi na birnin, wanda ke zaune a ƙarshe na wani ɗan ƙaramin ziri mai tsawo, ƙila shi ya faɗaɗa girma na tsunami ɗin, inji ta.

rows.output: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin "mai faɗi" kuma ya ce dubban gidajen, asibitoci, shaguna, da otal-otal sun ruguje.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin “mai yawa” kuma ya ce dubun-dubata na gidaje, asibitoci, shagunan cinikayya da otel-otel duk sun ruguje.

rows.output: An samu gawawar wasu wadanda suka mutu a karkashin tarkacen gine-ginen da suka ruguje, ya ce, ya kuma kara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma 29 sun bace.
rows.reference: An sami gawarwakin waɗanda abin ya shafa a maƙale a ƙarƙashin gine-gine da suka rushe, inji shi, ya kuma ƙara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma an rasa 29.

rows.output: Nugroho ya ce, an samu asarar rayuka da kuma lalacewar ababen more rayuwa za su iya karuwa a gabar tekun, kimanin kilomita 300 (mil 190) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala, wanda ke kusa da cibiyar girgizar kasa.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya ce yawan masu mutuwar da lalacewar zai ƙaru sosai a layin bakin teku kilomita 300 (mil 190) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala,

rows.output: Hirar "ta yi cikas gaba daya ba tare da wani bayani ba" daga Donggala, in ji Nugroho.
rows.reference: Sadarwa “gaba ɗaya sun tsaya cik kuma babu labari” daga Donggala, jinji Nugroho.

rows.output: Akwai sama da mutane 300,000 da ke zaune a wurin, a cewar wata sanarwa ta Red Cross, inda ta kara da cewa ma'aikatan su da masu aikin sa na tafiya zuwa wuraren da abin ya shafa.
rows.reference: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zauna a can,” inji ƙungiyar agaji ta Red Cross a cikin wata sanarwa, tana mai ƙarin cewa ma’aikatanta da masu sa-kai sun nufi yankunan da abin ya shafa.

rows.output: "Wannan al'amari ne mai ban tausayi, amma zai iya tsananta sosai," in ji ta.
rows.reference: “Wannan tuni wani bala’i ne, amma zai iya ƙara muni,” inji ta.

rows.output: Hukumar ta fuskanci sukar da yawa a ranar Asabar saboda rashin sanar da cewa wani tsunami ya afku a Palu, duk da cewa jami'an sun ce igiyoyin sun zo cikin lokaci da aka fitar da gargadin.
rows.reference: An soki hukumar a ranar Asabar sosai don rashin sanarwa cewa wata tsunami za ta afka wa Palu, kodayake jami’ai sun ce igiyoyin ruwa sun zo a tsakanin lokacin da aka fitar da gargaɗin.

rows.output: A cikin bidiyon da ba na sana'a ba da aka raba a shafukan sada zumunta, wani mutum a bene na sama na wani gini ana jin yana ihu da gargaɗi game da ambaliya mai zuwa zuwa mutane a kan tituna.
rows.reference: Wani bidiyon da ba ƙwararre ba da aka raba ta kafar sada zumunta za a iya jin wani mutum a kan saman daɓe na wani gini yana ihun girgiza gargaɗi na kusantowar tsunami ga mutane da ke titin ƙasan.

rows.output: A cikin mintuna, katangar ruwa ta fado kan bakin teku, tana ɗaukar gine-gine da motoci.
rows.reference: A cikin mintina wani bango na ruwa ya faɗo a kan tekun, yana ɗaukewa gine-gine da ƙananan motoci.

rows.output: Reuters bai samu damar tabbatar da bidiyon nan da nan ba.
rows.reference: Kamfanin dillacin labarai na Reuters ba iya tantance bidiyon ba nan da nan.

rows.output: Guguwar ta haifar da gagarumin katsewar wutar lantarki da ta katse sadarwa a kusa da Palu, wanda ya sa ya yi wahala ga hukumomi su tsara aikin ceto.
rows.reference: Girgizar ƙasar da tsunamin sun haifar da katsewar lantarki da yanke sadarwa a kewayen Palu inda ya haifar da wahala ga hukumomi wajen haɗin gamayyar ƙoƙare-ƙoƙare na ceto.

rows.output: Sojoji sun fara aika jiragen ruwa masu kaya da agajin da aka samu daga Jakarta da sauran biranen, a cewar hukumomi, amma ‘yan gudun hijira har yanzu suna buƙatar abinci da sauran abubuwan da ake buƙata.
rows.reference: Sojoji sun fara aika manyan jiragen ɗaukan kaya da tallafi daga Jakarta da sauran birane, inji hukumomi, amma waɗanda aka kwashen har yanzu suna sosai buƙatar abinci da sauran muhimman kayayyaki.

rows.output: An bude filin jirgin sama na birnin ne kawai don aikin agaji kuma zai ci gaba da rufewa har zuwa Oktoba.
rows.reference: An sake buɗe filin jirgin sama na birnin kaɗai don ƙoƙare-ƙoƙaren kayan agaji kuma zai kasance a rufe sai har Octoba.

rows.output: Shugaban Joko Widodo ya yi shiri ya ziyarci cibiyoyin gaggawa a Palu a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: An tsara Shugaba Joko Widodo zai ziyarci cibiyoyin kwashewa mutane a cikin Palu a ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: Indoneshiya ta fuskanci tsunami mai muni, wanda ya kai sama da mutane 800.
rows.reference: Ƙididdigar Mutuwar Tsunami a Indonesiya Ta Haura 800

rows.output: Yana da matuƙar muni.
rows.reference: Abin Ya Ɓaci Sosai.

rows.output: Yayin da ma'aikatan Vision na Duniya daga Donggala suka isa birnin Palu cikin aminci, inda ma'aikatan ke kwanciya a cikin sansanonin tarpaulin da aka kafa a filin gidan su, sun ga lalacewar da ta faru a hanya, in ji Mr. Doseba.
rows.reference: Kodayake ma’aikatan World Vision sun koma birnin Palu lafiya ƙalau daga Donggala, inda ma’aikatan ke zaune a matsugunan tanfol da aka kafa a farfajiyar ofishin nasu, sun nuna wani hali na rugujewa a kan hanyar, inji Mista Doseba.

rows.output: "Suna cewa sun ga gungun gidajen da aka lalata," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Sun faɗa mun sun ga gidaje da yawa da suka rushe,” inji shi.

rows.output: Yana da matuƙar muni.
rows.reference: Abin ya ɓaci sosai.

rows.output: Ko da yaushe, yayin da kungiyar agaji ta fara motsa jikinta na fara aikin agaji, wasu sun yi korafi cewa ma'aikata na agajin kasashen waje da suka yi zurfafa nazari sun hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.
rows.reference: Duk da gungu-gungun ‘yan agaji da suka fara wata babbar hoɓɓasa ta fara aikin tallafi na bala’i, wasu sun yi ƙorafi cewa ma’aikatan agaji na waje da ke ƙwarewa sosai ana hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.

rows.output: Bisa ga dokokin Indonesia, kuɗaɗen, kayan aiki da ma'aikata daga ƙasashen waje za su iya fara guduwa ne kawai idan an bayyana wurin bala'in a matsayin yanki na bala'i na kasa.
rows.reference: A cewar ƙa’idojin Indonesiya, kashe kuɗaɗe, samarwa da ba da ma’aikata daga ƙasashen waje kawai zai fara ne idan an furta wuri na fitina a matsayin zango na bala’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: Har yanzu hakan bai faru ba.
rows.reference: Hakan har yanzu bai faru ba.

rows.output: "Har yanzu bala'i ne na matakin lardi," in ji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun kungiyar agajin agaji ta Indonesia.
rows.reference: “Har yanzu wani lebur ne yankin bala’i,” inji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun Red Cross ta Indonesiya.

rows.output: "Da zarar gwamnatin ta ce, "Lafiya, wannan wata matsala ce ta kasa," za mu iya bude don taimakon kasa da kasa amma har yanzu ba a samu matsayin ba."
rows.reference: Da zarar gwamnatin ta ce, “Ya yi, wannan zai zama wani bala’i na ƙasa,” za mu buɗe don taimakon ƙasa-da-ƙasa amma babu matsayin har yanzu.”

rows.output: A lokacin da dare na biyu ya sauko a Palu bayan girgizar kasa da ambaliya da suka faru a ranar Juma'a, abokai da dangi na wadanda har yanzu ba a samu ba sun yi fatan cewa masu son su za su kasance abin al'ajabi da zai sa labaran tashin hankali na halitta su yi haske.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda dare na biyu ya faɗa kan Palu bayan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami ta ranar Jumu’a, abokai da iyali na waɗanda suka ɓata suna ta fatan cewa ‘yan uwan nasu za su zama mu’ujizozi da za su rayar da layukan labari marar daɗi na bala’o’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, wani yaro ya fito daga cikin bututun ruwan.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, an ciro wani ƙaramin yaro daga wata matattar datti.

rows.output: A ranar Lahadi, masu ceto sun sako wata mata da aka binne ta a karkashin tarkacen gini na tsawon kwanaki biyu tare da jikinta na uwa a gefenta.
rows.reference: A ranar Lahadi, masu ceto sun ‘yantar da wata mata wanda ta kasance tana ƙarƙashin burbushi na kwanaki biyu tare da gawar mahaifiyarta kusa da ita.

rows.output: Gendon Subandono, kocin tawagar paragliding ta kasa ta Indonesia, ya horar da 'yan paragliding biyu da suka bace don gasar Asiya, wanda ya kare a watan da ya gabata a Indonesia.
rows.reference: Gendon Subandono, mai horar da ‘yan wasa na Ɗƙungiyar ‘yan sauka daga sama na Indonesiya, ya horar da ‘yan wasan biyu da suka bace na Wasannin Asiya, wanda aka gama a farkon wannan watan a cikin Indonesiya.

rows.output: Wasu daga cikin wadanda aka kama a Otal din Roa Roa, da suka hada da Mista Mandagi, daliban sa ne.
rows.reference: Saura daga cikin waɗanda aka rutsa da su a otel ɗin Roa Roa, har da Mista Mandagi, ɗalibansa ne.

rows.output: "A matsayin babban ɗan wasan tsalle-tsalle, ina da nauyina na motsin rai," ya ce.
rows.reference: “A matsayi wani babba a cikin wasan saukowa daga saman, ni ma ina nawa taƙaicin da nake ji,” inji shi.

rows.output: Mista Gendon ya ba da labarin yadda, a sa'o'i bayan labarin rugujewar otal din Roa Roa ya bazu a cikin al'ummar paragliding, ya yi ƙoƙarin aika saƙonni na WhatsApp ga 'yan wasa na Palu, waɗanda suke halartar bikin bakin teku.
rows.reference: Mista Gendon ya ba da bayanin yadda aka yi, a cikin sa’o’i bayan labarin rushewar otel ɗin Roa Roa da aka watsa a tsakanin al’ummar wasan saukowa daga saman, ya aika sakonnin WhatsApp a dugunzume zuwa masu gasa ta Palu, waɗanda ke shiga cikin bikin na bakin tekun.

rows.output: Saƙoninsa, duk da haka, ya haifar da alamar duba mai launin toka guda ɗaya, maimakon alamar duban shuɗi guda biyu.
rows.reference: Sakonninsa, kodayake, kawai sun haifar da alamar launin toka guda mai zane, a maimakon wani guda biyu na zane-zane shudi.

rows.output: "Ina ganin hakan na nufin sakon ba a isar da su ba," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ina jin yana nufi ba a aika sakonni ne ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: Masu sata sun ceci dala 26,750 a lokacin cike da na'urar ATM a Newport on the Levee

rows.output: An yi sata ne a ranar Juma'a da safe, an sace dala 26,750 daga ma'aikacin Brink's da yake cike da na'urar ATM a Newport on the Levee, a cewar wata sanarwa daga sashen 'yan sanda na Newport.
rows.reference: Ɓarayi a ranar Juma’a da safe sun sace dala 26,750 daga wurin wani ma’aikacin Brink da ke sake cika wani ATM a Newport a kan Daɓe, a cewar wani labari da aka sake daga Ma’aikatar ‘Yan Sanda ta Newport.

rows.output: Direban motar ya fara fitar da wani ATM a cikin wurin nishaɗi kuma yana shiryawa ya kai ƙarin kudi, an rubuta Det. Dennis McCarthy a cikin sanarwar.
rows.reference: Direban ƙaramar motar yana cirewa wani ATM a cikin wani gini na nishaɗi da shiryawa don kawo ƙarin kuɗi, Det. Dennis McCarthy ya rubuta a cikin sanarwar.

rows.output: Yayin da yake cikin aiki, wani mutum ya "gudu daga bayan ma'aikacin Brink's" ya sace jaka da kudi da aka yi niyyar isarwa.
rows.reference: A lokacin da yake cikin aiki, wani mutum “ya zo a guje daga bayan ma’aikacin na Brink” kuma ya saci jakar kuɗi da za a kawo.

rows.output: Shaidu sun ga wasu masu laifi da dama suna gudu daga wurin, a cewar sakin, amma ‘yan sanda ba su bayyana adadin wadanda suka shiga lamarin ba.
rows.reference: Shaidun gani da ido sun ga waɗanda ake zargi da yawa suna gudu daga wurin da aka yi laifin a cewar sanarwar, amma ‘yan sanda ba su fayyace yawan waɗanda ke cikin ba.

rows.output: Wadanda ke da bayanai game da asalinsu su tuntubi ‘yan sanda na Newport a 859-292-3680.
